company: Smith Family Sawmill and Tree Works

reviews.text: Unbelievable work and by far the fairest price compared to any other company we had give estimates. What would’ve taken weeks to do Mr. Smith did in 1 and half days.
reviews.author: Frank M.

reviews.text: We have had AJ remove several leaning or dead trees. Great communication and rates. A pleasure to work with.

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this business. The price was very reasonable. They were so professional along with great customer service. They went an extra mile by finding the area my daughter carved her initials when she was little.
